name: Decision Integrity
description: Evaluate whether represented evidence and authority warrant a requested action while preserving qualifiers, unknowns, provenance, jurisdiction, and decision boundaries.

skills.name: Evaluate Decision Integrity
skills.description: Check whether the represented evidence, warrants, qualifiers, unknowns, provenance, and asserted authority support a requested action.
examples: Does this represented evidence warrant the requested recommendation?
Is this proposed action within the authority represented in this record?
